title: Waveform Relaxation for Field/Circuit Coupled DAEs with Generalized Capacitances
summary: Field/circuit coupling is a common approach when a lumped representation of a certain electrotechnical device is not accurate enough. To exploit existing code and underlying properties of the coupled systems, cosimulation techniques such as waveform relaxation can be used. The coupled system is of differential-algebraic type, which can potentially lead to divergence. This paper presents a novel, sufficient topological convergence criterion for field/circuit coupled systems of higher index containing a generalized capacitance. Hereby, the criterion holds for a full range of field systems…
